More than a controller
Today’s control systems must do more than just control machines. They must deliver scalable performance, enable safety and security and support digital 
transformation across operations. The ControlLogix ® family of controllers is designed to meet these evolving demands, uniting high-speed performance, 
flexibility and integration. 
As a part of Rockwell Automation’s Integrated Architecture ®, the ControlLogix family simplifies system design and enables consistent control strategies. 
Whether you’re optimizing legacy processes or scaling up digital initiatives, ControlLogix provides the reliability and power you need to succeed with compatible 
form and fit across models  . 
With ControlLogix, you’re not just choosing a controller. You’re choosing a platform that evolves with your business, empowers your teams and drives smarter,  
safer and more connected operations.

ControlLogix 5590
A NEW PERFORMANCE AND SCALABILITY
The ControlLogix® 5590 family is Rockwell Automation’s most advanced control offering — developed for the future  
of manufacturing, where big data, advanced analytics and digital twin commissioning are reshaping what  
automation can achieve.
Building on the foundation of ControlLogix 5570 and ControlLogix 5580, the ControlLogix 5590 delivers  
high performance, increased memory capacity and built-in functional safety features to meet  
the needs of your most data-intensive and mission-critical applications. 
Engineered for smart manufacturing
ControlLogix 5590 empowers enterprises that are integrating  
edge computing, digital twins and smart analytics directly into  
their control systems. Whether it’s predictive maintenance,  
dynamic batching or enterprise-level asset optimization,  
ControlLogix 5590 supports real-time control at scale.

Key benefits:
• Extended capacity: Memory capacity up to 80 MB, ideal for large-scale   
 automation and control systems.
• Enhanced redundancy: Minimal switchover time and uninterrupted   
 operation in high availability systems.
• Cloud and edge integration: Built to align with Rockwell Automation’s   
 Studio 5000 Logix Designer® solutions.
• Security by design: Conforms to IEC 62443-4-2, with firmware verification  
 and cyberattack mitigation.
• Third-party interoperability: Integrates easily with smart sensors via   
 standard protocols (OPC UA, MQTT).
  Applications:
Process automation: PlantPAx® compatibility allow for unified integration with 
visualization and analytics platforms.
Safety systems: With built-in functional safety and SIL 2 compliance, the 5590 
is used in applications requiring personnel and equipment protection — such as 
press control, emergency stop systems, and hazardous area automation.
IT/OT convergence control: More secure architecture and data connectivity 
enable real-time communication between plant-floor devices and enterprise 
systems to bridge operational data with cloud and MES platforms.
• Increased memory and faster scan times
•  Supports up to 512 motion axes and 600+ Ethernet 
devices in a system
• Up to 80 MB of memory
• 1 GB dual-port Ethernet
• Integrated CIP Security, secure boot and    
 device-level protection
• OPC UA enabled for seamless IT/OT interoperability
• Supports PlantPAx and Logix SIS ® for unified   
 process and safety control

ControlLogix 5580
HIGH-SPEED CONTROL FOR A MORE CONNECTED ENTERPRISE
The ControlLogix® 5580 controller family delivers the performance required for high-speed, data-intensive 
applications. With faster processing than previous generations and support for up to 256 axes of motion, 
ControlLogix 5580 is built to tackle smart manufacturing challenges head-on.
Scalable, more secure and smarter technology
Whether it’s real-time motion, complex safety applications  
or massive data throughput, ControlLogix 5580 gives you  
the tools to do more, faster, and with less complexity.  
And with built-in security features, ControlLogix 5580  
helps you comply with industry standards like  
IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.

ControlLogix 5570
PROVEN VERSATILITY FOR A RANGE OF APPLICATIONS
The ControlLogix® 5570 family delivers a balance of power, scalability and reliability for diverse control 
applications, from small machine control to large process systems. Built on a modular platform, ControlLogix 5570 
controllers are engineered to meet your operational demands while offering flexibility in your application design.  
Designed for broad industrial use
ControlLogix 5570 controllers support a wide range of automation disciplines,  
including discrete, process, motion and safety — all within a single controller.  
This means less design complexity and lower total cost of ownership (TCO)  
across the lifecycle of your system. With multiple form factors —  
including standard, safety, extreme  
temperature and On-Machine™   
models — it’s ideal for a wide  
range of environments.

Key benefits:
• Integrated control: Combine multiple control types in one platform to   
 reduce hardware and streamline engineering.
• Flexible communication: With support for EtherNet/IP™ , ControlNet™ ,   
 DeviceNet ™  and other networks, 5570 helps achieve smooth integration with  
 legacy and modern devices.
• Easy programming: Use Studio 5000 Logix Designer® for development,   
 configuration and maintenance — offering a consistent user experience   
 across the ControlLogix platform.
• Memory options: Expanded user memory, depending on model (0.5…32MB). 
    Applications:
• OEM equipment: Modular design allows for reuse across machine types.
• Process control: Controller redundancy options have yielded proven   
 reliability in industries like chemical, oil and gas and water/wastewater.
• Safety integration: When paired with GuardLogix technology,  
 ControlLogix 5570 can support SIL 2 / PLd and SIL 3 / PLe applications.
• Up to 32 MB memory
• Full controller redundancy and RIUP support
• Supports EtherNet/IP , ControlNet, DeviceNet    
 and legacy networks
• Compatible with Studio 5000 ® for  
 unified programming
• SIL 3 functional safety with GuardLogix variants
• Conformal coating and XT options for  
 harsh environments

DESIGN WITH PURPOSE, CONTROL WITH CONFIDENCE

FULL FEATURE SET MODERN DESIGN PRACTICES
• On-premise multi-discipline design in one environment
• Premier integration with Rockwell Automation hardware  
 and software
• Design and test motion with physical drives or emulated axis
• Leverage pre-configured or custom libraries to accelerate  
 code development
• Perform automated tests for controller code using a  
 well-documented API
• Cloud-engineered, software-defined industrial  
 automation design
• Integrated AI-powered design assistant
• Multiple controllers and multiple firmware revision support
• Multi-user collaboration enabled by integrated version control
• SaaS offering with new capabilities delivered on a  
 quarterly basis
The ControlLogix® family of programmable automation controllers (PACs) supports modern, scalable control systems and gives users 
the flexibility to program controllers using either Studio 5000 Logix Designer® or FactoryTalk® Design Studio™ . With the right design 
environment, this combination of hardware and software enables manufacturers to stay competitive as industrial demands evolve.
Did you know? When you purchase a FactoryTalk Design Studio Core subscription, it includes a Studio 5000 Logix Designer Professional 
subscription, giving you the flexibility to choose the design experience that best fits your application.
